summary: Markets are navigating dueling crosscurrents as November 12 unfolds. A hot October CPI print—headline up 0.4% month-over-month and core up 0.3%, both above forecasts—ignited a repricing of December FOMC expectations, with markets now pricing almost 60 basis points of tightening through March and a slim but uncomfortable chance of a 50-basis-point hike next month. Fed Governor Waller and Dallas Fed's Logan opened the door to faster hikes earlier this week, though Cleveland's hawkish Beth Hammack stopped short of endorsing a larger move today. The 2-year Treasury yield surged 17 basis points Tuesday and added another 3 basis points Thursday, trading at 4.77%. Meanwhile, Nvidia shares plunged as much as 13% in early trading after reports that the board ousted CEO Jensen Huang following allegations of a second extramarital affair and possible intelligence concerns; the stock later trimmed losses to around 5%. Broader equity indices wobbled but turned positive by midday, with the S&P 500 up 0.12% and the Dow up 0.25%, as AI infrastructure play CoreWeave's blowout Q3 results (revenue up 168% year-over-year) provided a counterweight. Crypto remains under pressure: Bitcoin briefly broke below $72,000 for the first time since August, weighed down by five consecutive days of ETF outflows totaling $1.44 billion—BlackRock's IBIT alone shed $270 million Wednesday—and a $14.2 billion stablecoin supply contraction, the largest since 2022. MSCI's decision to remove MicroStrategy from its benchmark indexes added to selling pressure in crypto-adjacent equities.

signals.title: Hot CPI fuels Fed 50bp hike speculation, yields surge
signals.desc: October CPI came in at 0.4% m/m vs forecast, pushing markets to price 60bp of tightening through March and sending the 2-year yield up 20bp this week to 4.77%.

signals.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang ousted, shares drop 13% intraday
signals.desc: Board removed Huang after reports of second affair and intelligence concerns; CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO, with multiple Wall Street downgrades following the news.

signals.title: CoreWeave blowout earnings rally tech stocks Wednesday
signals.desc: AI infrastructure provider reported Q3 revenue of $3.66B (up 168% y/y) and raised 2026 guidance by 26%, sparking a 1.6% Nasdaq rally and 2% Apple close at record $355.63.

signals.title: Bitcoin ETF outflows hit $1.44B over five days, BTC breaks $72K
signals.desc: BlackRock's IBIT shed $270M Wednesday alone as persistent institutional withdrawals and $14.2B stablecoin supply drop pushed BTC to lowest level since August.

signals.title: MSCI drops MicroStrategy from indexes, crypto stocks hit
signals.desc: Index operator confirmed removal of Bitcoin treasury companies including MSTR from benchmarks effective November 30, pressuring crypto-adjacent equities and highlighting financing model risk.

verdict: Hawkish Fed repricing and Nvidia leadership turmoil create cross-pressures, but equities finding support from AI infrastructure strength while crypto faces sustained institutional exodus.
